meaning:
δειγματίζω
(δεῖγμα),
a rare word (ICC, ll. with), to make a show of, to expose: Mat.1:19 (Rec. παραδ-, which see), Col.2:15.†
(AS)
glosses: made a public spectacle of them

renderings.bsb: He made a public spectacle of them
renderings.kjv: he made a shew of them

elsewhere.note: Joseph, her husband, being a righteous man, and not willing to make her a public example, intended to put her away secretly.
Having stripped the principalities and the powers, he made a show of them openly, triumphing over them in it.
